hi.L: और ऐसा होता था कि जिस समय लेवियों के हाथ से संदूक राजा के अधिकारियों के पास लाया जाता, और जब वे देखते कि रुपया बहुत [है], तब राजा का लेखक और महायाजक का अधिकारी आकर संदूक को ख़ाली करते, और उसे उठाकर उसके स्थान पर लौटा देते। इस प्रकार वे दिन-दिन करते रहे, और उन्होंने बहुत-सा रुपया इकट्ठा किया।
hi.B: जब भी लेवी संदूक को राजा के अधिकारियों के पास लाते और वे देखते कि उसमें बहुत धन है, तब राजा का सचिव और महायाजक का अधिकारी आकर संदूक को ख़ाली करते, फिर उसे उठाकर उसके स्थान पर लौटा देते। वे दिन-दिन ऐसा करते रहे और उन्होंने बहुत-सा धन इकट्ठा किया।
hi.R: समय-समय पर लेवी संदूक को राजा के अधिकारियों के पास ले आते थे। जब वे देखते कि उसमें बहुत धन है, तब राजा का सचिव और महायाजक का अधिकारी आकर उसे ख़ाली करते। फिर वे संदूक को उसके स्थान पर वापस ले जाते। वे हर दिन ऐसा करते रहे, और उन्होंने बहुत-सा धन इकट्ठा किया।

ru.L: И было, во время, [когда] приносили ящик к надзору царя руками левитов, и когда видели, что много серебра, то приходил писец царя и уполномоченный первосвященника, и опорожняли ящик, и брали его, и возвращали его на его место. Так делали день за днём и собрали серебра в изобилии.
ru.B: Всякий раз, когда левиты приносили ящик к царским надзирателям и те видели, что в нём много серебра, приходили царский писец и уполномоченный первосвященника, опорожняли ящик и относили его обратно на место. Так делали день за днём и собрали очень много серебра.
ru.R: Время от времени левиты приносили ящик к царским чиновникам. Когда они видели, что в нём много денег, приходили царский писец и помощник первосвященника и опорожняли ящик. Потом ящик относили обратно на место. Так делали каждый день и собрали очень много денег.

ja.L: そして、レビ人たちの手によって箱が王の役人たちのもとに運ばれる時、銀が多いのを彼らが見ると、王の書記と首席の祭司の役人が来て、箱を空にし、それを担いで元の場所に戻した。彼らは日ごとにこのようにして、銀を多く集めた。
ja.B: 箱がレビ人たちによって王の役人たちのもとに運ばれ、中に多くの銀があるのがわかると、そのたびに、王の書記と首席祭司の役人が来て箱を空にし、それを元の場所に戻した。彼らは毎日このようにして、多くの銀を集めた。
ja.R: レビ人たちは、ときどき、箱を王の役人たちのところへ運びました。お金がたくさんたまっているのを見ると、王の書記と大祭司の役人が来て、箱を空にしました。そして、箱を元の場所に戻しました。毎日このようにして、たくさんのお金を集めました。

decisions.choice: the king's scribe and the chief priest's officer: differs from 2 Kings 12:11
decisions.reason: In 2 Kings 12:11 the king's scribe and "the high priest" himself come up and count the money. Here the chief priest sends his officer. In both accounts the palace and the temple handle the money together, so that it is counted openly.

decisions.choice: the king's scribe: the royal secretary
decisions.reason: The scribe was one of the king's chief officials, who kept records and handled royal business (2 Samuel 8:17; 1 Kings 4:3).

decisions.choice: the oversight of the king: the king's officers
decisions.reason: The word means oversight or charge, and here stands for the men the king had put in charge of the money.

decisions.choice: day by day: whenever there was need
decisions.reason: The emptying was done again and again, as often as the chest filled. "Day by day" stresses how often it happened.

decisions.choice: the king's secretary
decisions.reason: As at 2 Kings 12:11, Balanced and Readable say "secretary" for the royal scribe (m2); Literal keeps "scribe".

decisions.choice: short sentences in order of events
decisions.reason: Readable divides the long Hebrew sentence into four sentences in the order things were done.

decisions.choice: "el escriba del rey" (L); "el secretario del rey" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Spanish 2 Kings 12:11 and the terms note: Balanced and Readable name the office "secretario"; Literal keeps "escriba", as the English keeps "scribe".

decisions.choice: "le scribe du roi" (Literal); "le secrétaire du roi" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As French 2 Kings 12:11 for the royal secretary; Literal keeps the Hebrew word.

decisions.choice: "thư ký của vua"
decisions.reason: The terms note's word for the royal secretary.

decisions.choice: o escrivão (L), o secretário (B, R) do rei; o encarregado (L, B), o auxiliar (R) do sacerdote-chefe (L, B), do sumo sacerdote (R)
decisions.reason: The royal scribe (m2) keeps the words of 2 Kings 12:11 in Portuguese, "escrivão" at Literal and "secretário" at Balanced and Readable; where Kings has the high priest himself, Chronicles has his officer (m1), and so does the Portuguese. The repeated emptying takes the imperfect, as 2 Kings 12:10-11 does in Portuguese (m4).

decisions.choice: The Amharic of 2 Kings 12:11 is kept where the Hebrew is the same; "በሣጥኑ ውስጥ ብዙ ገንዘብ … ባዩ ጊዜ" and "የንጉሡ ጸሐፊ" are kept; Chronicles has the Levites bring the chest, "the officer of the chief priest" ("የሊቀ ካህናቱ ሹም") for "the high priest", and the chest emptied and returned where Kings has the money bagged and counted.
decisions.reason: Chronicles retells Kings here. The terms list keeps the parallel's wording word for word where the Hebrew agrees and follows Chronicles' own Hebrew where it differs, so that a reader comparing the two sees only the real differences.

decisions.choice: "लेखक" (L); "सचिव" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The king's scribe is the royal secretary (meaning m2), as the English Balanced says.

decisions.choice: sofer hammelekh "王の書記" every level; peqid kohen harosh "首席の祭司の役人" (L), "首席祭司の役人" (B), "大祭司の役人" (R).
decisions.reason: Kohen harosh as in 2 Kings 25:18 (首席の祭司 L, 首席祭司 B, 大祭司 R).

source.text: וַיִּתְּנֵ֨הוּ הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ וִֽיהוֹיָדָ֗ע אֶל־עוֹשֵׂה֙ מְלֶ֨אכֶת֙ עֲבוֹדַ֣ת בֵּית־יְהוָ֔ה וַיִּֽהְי֤וּ שֹׂכְרִים֙ חֹצְבִ֣ים וְחָרָשִׁ֔ים לְחַדֵּ֖שׁ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וְ֠גַם לְחָרָשֵׁ֤י בַרְזֶל֙ וּנְחֹ֔שֶׁת לְחַזֵּ֖ק אֶת־בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And gave it the king and Jehoiada to [the] doer of [the] work of [the] service of [the] house of Yahweh, and they were hiring hewers and craftsmen to renew [the] house of Yahweh, and also to craftsmen of iron and bronze to repair the house of Yahweh.

en.L: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to the doer of the work of the service of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and they were hiring hewers and craftsmen to renew the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and also craftsmen in iron and bronze to repair the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: The king and Jehoiada gave the money to those in charge of the work on the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and they hired stonecutters and craftsmen to restore the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. They also hired workers in iron and bronze to mend the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: The king and Jehoiada gave the money to the men in charge of the work on the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. These men hired stonecutters and skilled workers to restore the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. They also hired people who worked with iron and bronze to repair the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y el rey y Joiada lo daban al que hacía la obra del servicio de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y contrataban canteros y artesanos para renovar la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y también artesanos del hierro y del bronce para reparar la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: El rey y Joiada daban el dinero a los encargados de la obra en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y ellos contrataban canteros y artesanos para restaurar la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. También contrataban a trabajadores del hierro y del bronce para arreglar la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: El rey y Joiada daban el dinero a los hombres encargados de la obra en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Ellos contrataban canteros y obreros especializados para restaurar el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. También contrataban a gente que trabajaba el hierro y el bronce para reparar el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et le roi et Yehoyada le donnaient à celui qui faisait l’ouvrage du service de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et ceux-ci engageaient des tailleurs de pierre et des artisans pour renouveler la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et aussi des artisans du fer et du bronze pour réparer la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Le roi et Yehoyada remettaient l’argent aux responsables des travaux de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qui engageaient des tailleurs de pierre et des artisans pour restaurer la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Ils engageaient aussi des ouvriers du fer et du bronze pour remettre en état la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Le roi et Yehoyada donnaient l’argent aux hommes qui dirigeaient les travaux du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Ces hommes engageaient des tailleurs de pierre et des ouvriers qualifiés pour restaurer le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Ils engageaient aussi des gens qui travaillaient le fer et le bronze pour réparer le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Mfalme na Yehoyada wakaitoa kwa mfanyaji wa kazi ya huduma ya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nao walikuwa wakiajiri wachongaji wa mawe na mafundi ili kuifanya upya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na pia mafundi wa chuma na shaba ili kuitengeneza nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Mfalme na Yehoyada waliwapa fedha hiyo wale waliosimamia kazi ya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nao wakaajiri wachongaji wa mawe na mafundi ili kuirejesha nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Waliajiri pia mafundi wa chuma na wa shaba ili kuikarabati nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Mfalme na Yehoyada waliwapa fedha hiyo watu waliosimamia kazi ya hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Watu hao wakaajiri wachongaji wa mawe na mafundi stadi ili kulirejesha hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Waliajiri pia watu waliofanya kazi ya chuma na shaba ili kulitengeneza hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Vua và Giê-hô-gia-đa giao bạc cho những người làm công việc phục vụ nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và họ thuê thợ đẽo đá và thợ thủ công để tu bổ nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, cùng thợ sắt và thợ đồng để sửa chữa nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Vua và Giê-hô-gia-đa giao bạc cho những người coi sóc công việc nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và họ thuê thợ đẽo đá cùng thợ thủ công để tu bổ nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Họ cũng thuê thợ sắt và thợ đồng để sửa sang nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Vua và Giê-hô-gia-đa giao tiền cho những người coi sóc công việc tại đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Những người này thuê thợ đẽo đá và thợ lành nghề để tu bổ đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Họ cũng thuê thợ sắt và thợ đồng để sửa chữa đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 왕과 여호야다가 그것을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집 일을 하는 자에게 주었고, 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집을 새롭게 하려고 석수들과 기술자들을 고용했으며, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집을 수리하려고 철과 놋을 다루는 기술자들도 [고용했다].
ko.B: 왕과 여호야다는 그 돈을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집 공사를 맡은 감독들에게 주었다. 그들은 석수들과 기술자들을 고용하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집을 새롭게 고치게 했다. 또 철과 놋을 다루는 기술자들도 고용하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집을 보수하게 했다.
ko.R: 왕과 여호야다는 그 돈을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전 공사를 맡은 사람들에게 주었다. 그 사람들은 돌을 다듬는 사람들과 기술자들을 고용하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전을 새롭게 고쳤다. 또 쇠와 놋을 다루는 사람들도 고용하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전을 수리했다.

pt.L: E o rei e Joiada o davam ao que fazia o trabalho do serviço da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e eles contratavam cortadores de pedra e artífices para renovar a casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e também artífices de ferro e de bronze para reparar a casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: O rei e Joiada entregavam o dinheiro aos que faziam o trabalho na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e estes contratavam cortadores de pedra e artífices para restaurar a casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Contratavam também artífices em ferro e bronze para consertar a casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: O rei e Joiada entregavam o dinheiro aos homens encarregados da obra do templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Esses homens contratavam cortadores de pedra e trabalhadores habilidosos para restaurar o templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Também contratavam pessoas que trabalhavam com ferro e bronze para consertar o templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.

am.L: ንጉሡና ዮዳሄም {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ቤት የአገልግሎቱን ሥራ ለሚሠራው ሰጡት፤ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ቤት ያድሱ ዘንድ ድንጋይ ጠራቢዎችንና ባለ ሙያዎችን፣ ደግሞም {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ቤት ይጠግኑ ዘንድ የብረትና የነሐስ ሠራተኞችን ይቀጥሩ ነበር።
am.B: ንጉሡና ዮዳሄ ገንዘቡን {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ ሥራ ላይ ለተሾሙት ሰጡ፤ እነርሱም {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ቤተ መቅደስ ለማደስ ድንጋይ ጠራቢዎችንና ባለ ሙያዎችን ቀጠሩ። {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ቤተ መቅደስ ለመጠገን የብረትና የነሐስ ሠራተኞችንም ደግሞ ቀጠሩ።
am.R: ንጉሡና ዮዳሄ ገንዘቡን {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ ሥራ ላይ ለተሾሙት ሰዎች ሰጡ። እነዚህ ሰዎች {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ቤተ መቅደስ ለማደስ ድንጋይ ጠራቢዎችንና የተካኑ ሠራተኞችን ቀጠሩ። {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ቤተ መቅደስ ለመጠገን ብረትና ነሐስ የሚሠሩ ሰዎችንም ደግሞ ቀጠሩ።

hi.L: और राजा और यहोयादा ने उसे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन की सेवा का काम करनेवाले को दिया, और वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन को नया करने के लिए पत्थर गढ़नेवालों और कारीगरों को, और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन की मरम्मत के लिए लोहे और पीतल के कारीगरों को भी, मज़दूरी पर रखते रहे।
hi.B: राजा और यहोयादा ने वह धन उन्हें दिया जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन के काम की देखरेख करते थे, और उन्होंने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन को फिर से ठीक करने के लिए पत्थर गढ़नेवालों और कारीगरों को मज़दूरी पर रखा। उन्होंने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन की मरम्मत के लिए लोहे और पीतल का काम करनेवालों को भी रखा।
hi.R: राजा और यहोयादा ने वह धन उन लोगों को दिया जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन के काम के अधिकारी थे। इन लोगों ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन को फिर से ठीक करने के लिए पत्थर गढ़नेवालों और कुशल कारीगरों को काम पर लगाया। उन्होंने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन की मरम्मत के लिए लोहे और पीतल का काम करनेवालों को भी लगाया।

ru.L: И давали его царь и Иодай исполнителю работы по служению в доме {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, и нанимали каменотёсов и мастеров, чтобы обновить дом {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, и также мастеров по железу и меди, чтобы чинить дом {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Царь и Иодай отдавали серебро тем, кто руководил работами в доме {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, а те нанимали каменотёсов и мастеров, чтобы восстановить дом {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. Нанимали и мастеров по железу и меди, чтобы чинить дом {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Царь и Иодай отдавали деньги людям, которые руководили работами в храме {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. Эти люди нанимали каменотёсов и умелых мастеров, чтобы восстановить храм {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. Нанимали и тех, кто работал с железом и медью, чтобы ремонтировать храм {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.

ja.L: そして王とヨヤダはそれを、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家の奉仕の工事を行う者に渡した。そして彼らは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家を新しくするために石切り工と職人たちを雇い、また{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家を修理するために、鉄と青銅の職人たちをも[雇った]。
ja.B: 王とヨヤダはその銀を、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家の工事を任されている者たちに渡した。彼らは石切り工と職人たちを雇って{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家を修復し、また鉄と青銅の職人たちも雇って{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家を補修した。
ja.R: 王とヨヤダは、そのお金を、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の神殿の工事を任された人たちに渡しました。この人たちは、石を切る人や腕のいい職人たちを雇って、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の神殿を修復しました。また、鉄や青銅の細工をする人たちも雇って、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の神殿を修理しました。

decisions.choice: the doer of the work: the overseers of the work
decisions.reason: The word is singular in form but stands for the men in charge of the work, who paid the workmen (2 Kings 12:12). Verse 13 uses the plural.

decisions.choice: hewers and craftsmen: stonecutters and skilled workers
decisions.reason: The first word is for those who cut or quarry stone. The second is a general word for a skilled craftsman, used with "of iron and bronze" for metalworkers; on its own here it most likely means workers in wood.

decisions.choice: workers in iron and bronze: not named in 2 Kings 12
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 12:12-13 names carpenters, builders, masons and stonecutters, and the purchase of timber and stone. Chronicles adds metalworkers, recalling the bronze work of Solomon's temple (2 Chronicles 4).

decisions.choice: restore ... mend (Balanced); restore ... repair (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has two verbs, "renew" and "repair" (verses 4-5); Balanced and Readable keep two different words.

decisions.choice: skilled workers
decisions.reason: Readable uses a general word, since the kind of craftsman is not stated (m2).

decisions.choice: ao que fazia (L), aos que faziam o trabalho (B), aos homens encarregados da obra (R); cortadores de pedra; renovar ... reparar (L), restaurar ... consertar (B, R)
decisions.reason: The overseers (m1) take the words 2 Kings 12:12 gives them in Portuguese, with Literal keeping the singular form; "cortadores de pedra" as 2 Kings 12:13. Each level keeps two verbs for the Hebrew "renew" and "repair" (r-en-1), the same words as verses 4-5.

decisions.choice: The Amharic of 2 Kings 12:12-13 is kept where the Hebrew is the same; "{{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ ሥራ ላይ ለተሾሙት" and "ድንጋይ ጠራቢዎች" (Balanced) are kept; Chronicles has the king and Jehoiada hand over the money and adds the workers in iron and bronze, and lacks the carpenters, masons and purchases of timber and stone.
decisions.reason: Chronicles retells Kings here. The terms list keeps the parallel's wording word for word where the Hebrew agrees and follows Chronicles' own Hebrew where it differs, so that a reader comparing the two sees only the real differences.

source.text: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֙ עֹשֵׂ֣י הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה וַתַּ֧עַל אֲרוּכָ֛ה לַמְּלָאכָ֖ה בְּיָדָ֑ם וַֽיַּעֲמִ֜ידוּ אֶת־בֵּ֧ית הָֽאֱלֹהִ֛ים עַל־מַתְכֻּנְתּ֖וֹ וַֽיְאַמְּצֻֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And worked [the] doers of the work, and went up healing for the work by their hand, and they set up [the] house of God on its measure and strengthened it.

en.L: And the doers of the work worked, and healing went up for the work by their hand, and they set up the house of God according to its measure and strengthened it.
en.B: So the workmen did their work, and the repairs went forward under their hands. They restored the house of God to its proper design and made it strong.
en.R: The workers did their job, and the repairs went well. They rebuilt God's temple as it was first planned, and they made it strong.

es.L: E hicieron los que hacían la obra, y subió la curación para la obra por mano de ellos, y levantaron la casa de Dios según su medida, y la fortalecieron.
es.B: Así los obreros hicieron su trabajo, y la reparación avanzó en sus manos. Restauraron la casa de Dios según su diseño original y la reforzaron.
es.R: Los obreros hicieron su trabajo, y las reparaciones salieron bien. Reconstruyeron el templo de Dios como se había planeado al principio, y lo dejaron firme.

fr.L: Et ceux qui faisaient l’ouvrage travaillèrent, et la guérison monta pour l’ouvrage par leur main, et ils rétablirent la maison de Dieu selon sa mesure et l’affermirent.
fr.B: Les ouvriers firent leur travail, et la réparation avança entre leurs mains. Ils remirent la maison de Dieu dans son état d’origine et la consolidèrent.
fr.R: Les ouvriers ont fait leur travail, et les réparations ont bien avancé. Ils ont reconstruit le temple de Dieu comme il avait été prévu au début, et ils l’ont rendu solide.

sw.L: Nao wafanyaji wa kazi wakafanya kazi, na uponyaji ukapanda kwa ajili ya kazi kwa mkono wao, wakaisimamisha nyumba ya Mungu kwa kipimo chake, wakaiimarisha.
sw.B: Basi wafanya kazi walifanya kazi yao, na matengenezo yakaendelea mikononi mwao. Wakairejesha nyumba ya Mungu katika umbo lake la awali, wakaiimarisha.
sw.R: Wafanya kazi walifanya kazi yao, na matengenezo yakaenda vizuri. Walilijenga upya hekalu la Mungu kama lilivyopangwa mwanzoni, wakalifanya imara.

vi.L: Những người làm việc ra công làm, và việc tu sửa tiến lên dưới tay họ; họ dựng lại nhà Đức Chúa Trời theo kích thước của nó và làm cho vững chắc.
vi.B: Vậy các thợ làm việc, và công cuộc tu sửa tiến triển dưới tay họ. Họ phục hồi nhà Đức Chúa Trời theo đúng thiết kế ban đầu và làm cho vững chắc.
vi.R: Các thợ làm việc, và việc sửa chữa tiến hành tốt đẹp. Họ xây lại đền thờ Đức Chúa Trời như thiết kế ban đầu và làm cho đền thờ vững chắc.

ko.L: 그리고 일하는 자들이 일하여, 그들의 손으로 그 일에 치유가 올라갔다. 그리고 그들이 하나님의 집을 그 규격대로 세우고 그것을 튼튼하게 했다.
ko.B: 일꾼들이 부지런히 일하여 수리 공사가 그들의 손에서 잘 진척되었다. 그들은 하나님의 집을 본래의 설계대로 세우고 튼튼하게 했다.
ko.R: 일꾼들은 열심히 일했고, 수리하는 일이 잘 되어 갔다. 그들은 하나님의 성전을 처음 설계한 대로 다시 세우고 튼튼하게 만들었다.

pt.L: E os que faziam o trabalho trabalharam, e a cura da obra avançou pela mão deles, e levantaram a casa de Deus segundo a sua medida e a fortaleceram.
pt.B: Assim os trabalhadores fizeram o seu trabalho, e os reparos avançaram nas suas mãos. Eles restauraram a casa de Deus de acordo com o seu projeto original e a deixaram firme.
pt.R: Os trabalhadores fizeram o seu serviço, e os consertos andaram bem. Eles reconstruíram o templo de Deus como tinha sido planejado no começo e o deixaram forte.

am.L: የሥራውም ሠሪዎች ሠሩ፤ በእጃቸውም ለሥራው ፈውስ ወጣ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት እንደ ልኩ አቆሙት፤ አጸኑትም።
am.B: ሠራተኞቹም ሠሩ፤ ዕድሳቱም በእጃቸው ተቀላጠፈ። የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ወደ ቀድሞ ንድፉ መልሰው አጸኑት።
am.R: ሠራተኞቹ ሥራቸውን ሠሩ፤ ዕድሳቱም በጥሩ ሁኔታ ቀጠለ። የእግዚአብሔርን ቤተ መቅደስ መጀመሪያ እንደ ታቀደው መልሰው ሠሩት፤ አጠነከሩትም።

hi.L: और काम करनेवालों ने काम किया, और उनके हाथ से काम की मरम्मत आगे बढ़ती गई, और उन्होंने परमेश्वर के भवन को उसके नाप के अनुसार खड़ा करके उसे दृढ़ किया।
hi.B: कारीगरों ने परिश्रम किया, और उनके हाथों मरम्मत का काम आगे बढ़ता गया। उन्होंने परमेश्वर के भवन को उसके ठीक नक़्शे के अनुसार फिर से खड़ा किया और उसे मज़बूत किया।
hi.R: कारीगरों ने अपना काम किया, और मरम्मत अच्छी तरह होती गई। उन्होंने परमेश्वर के भवन को वैसा ही फिर से बनाया जैसा वह पहले बनाया गया था, और उसे मज़बूत कर दिया।

ru.L: И работали исполнители работы, и поднималось исцеление для работы их руками, и поставили они дом Божий по его мере и укрепили его.
ru.B: Работники трудились, и починка успешно продвигалась в их руках. Они восстановили дом Божий в его прежнем виде и укрепили его.
ru.R: Работники делали своё дело, и ремонт шёл хорошо. Они восстановили Божий храм таким, каким он был задуман, и сделали его прочным.

ja.L: そして工事を行う者たちは働き、その手によって工事に回復が進んだ。そして彼らは神の家を、その寸法どおりに立て、それを堅固にした。
ja.B: こうして職人たちは仕事に励み、修理は彼らの手によって進んだ。彼らは神の家を元の設計どおりに建て直し、堅固なものにした。
ja.R: 職人たちはよく働き、修理はうまく進みました。そして、神の神殿を最初の設計どおりに建て直し、じょうぶにしました。

decisions.choice: healing went up: the repair advanced
decisions.reason: The word for repair is used of new flesh growing over a wound (Jeremiah 8:22; 30:17). The damaged house is pictured as being healed, and the healing "goes up", that is, makes progress.

decisions.choice: set up the house on its measure: restored it to its first plan
decisions.reason: The verb means to make stand. "Its measure" is the right size and design of the house, as Solomon built it. The work brought it back to that, and made it firm.

decisions.choice: the repairs went forward; the repairs went well
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the picture of healing means (m1); Literal keeps it.

decisions.choice: "subió la curación" (L); "la reparación avanzó" (B); "las reparaciones salieron bien" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of healing; Balanced and Readable say what it means (m1).

decisions.choice: "la guérison monta"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of healing (m1); Balanced and Readable give its sense.

decisions.choice: uponyaji ukapanda
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of healing (new flesh over a wound, m1); Balanced and Readable say "matengenezo" (repairs).

decisions.choice: "치유가 올라갔다" at Literal
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of the house healing like a wound (m1); Balanced and Readable give its sense.

decisions.choice: a cura da obra avançou (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of healing (m1), as the English does, with "avançou" for "went up", the sense of the verb here, since "a cura subiu" would not be understood in Portuguese.

decisions.choice: "healing went up for the work" is "ለሥራው ፈውስ ወጣ" (Literal); "ዕድሳቱ ተቀላጠፈ" (Balanced).
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of new flesh growing over a wound; the other levels say the repair went forward.

decisions.choice: "मरम्मत आगे बढ़ती गई" (L)
decisions.reason: Hebrew "healing went up" means the repair advanced (meaning m1); a word-for-word Hindi "healing" would not be understood, so Literal says repair.

decisions.choice: "回復が進んだ" for the healing that went up (arukhah), kept as an image at Literal; "修理は…進んだ" (B, R).
decisions.reason: Arukhah is the new flesh over a wound; Japanese 回復 keeps the picture without odd wording.

source.text: וּֽכְכַלּוֹתָ֡ם הֵבִ֣יאוּ לִפְנֵי֩ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ וִֽיהוֹיָדָ֜ע אֶת־שְׁאָ֣ר הַכֶּ֗סֶף וַיַּעֲשֵׂ֨הוּ כֵלִ֤ים לְבֵית־יְהוָה֙ כְּלֵ֣י שָׁרֵ֔ת וְהַעֲל֣וֹת וְכַפּ֔וֹת וּכְלֵ֥י זָהָ֖ב וָכָ֑סֶף וַ֠יִּֽהְיוּ מַעֲלִ֨ים עֹל֤וֹת בְּבֵית־יְהוָה֙ תָּמִ֔יד כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י יְהוֹיָדָֽע׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And when they finished they brought before the king and Jehoiada the rest of the money, and he made it vessels for [the] house of Yahweh, vessels of ministering and of offering up, and dishes and vessels of gold and silver; and they were offering up burnt offerings in [the] house of Yahweh continually all [the] days of Jehoiada.

en.L: And when they had finished, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, and it was made into vessels for the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, vessels for ministering and for offering up, and dishes, and vessels of gold and silver. And they were offering up burnt offerings in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} continually all the days of Jehoiada.
en.B: When they had finished, they brought what remained of the money to the king and Jehoiada, and with it they made articles for the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: articles for the service and for the burnt offerings, dishes, and other articles of gold and silver. All the days of Jehoiada, burnt offerings were offered continually in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: When the work was finished, the workers brought the money that was left to the king and Jehoiada. It was used to make things for the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: objects for the temple service and for burnt offerings, dishes, and other things made of gold and silver. As long as Jehoiada lived, burnt offerings were offered in the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} every day.

es.L: Y cuando acabaron, trajeron delante del rey y de Joiada el resto del dinero, y se hicieron con él utensilios para la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, utensilios para el servicio y para los holocaustos, y cucharones, y utensilios de oro y de plata. Y ofrecían holocaustos en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} continuamente, todos los días de Joiada.
es.B: Cuando terminaron, llevaron al rey y a Joiada el dinero que sobraba, y con él hicieron utensilios para la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}: utensilios para el servicio y para los holocaustos, cucharones y otros utensilios de oro y de plata. Durante todos los días de Joiada se ofrecieron holocaustos continuamente en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Cuando terminaron la obra, los trabajadores le llevaron al rey y a Joiada el dinero que sobró. Se usó para hacer objetos para el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}: objetos para el servicio del templo y para los holocaustos, cucharones y otras cosas hechas de oro y de plata. Mientras vivió Joiada, se ofrecieron holocaustos en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} todos los días.

fr.L: Et quand ils eurent fini, ils apportèrent devant le roi et Yehoyada le reste de l’argent, et on en fit des ustensiles pour la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, des ustensiles pour le service et pour les holocaustes, et des coupes, et des ustensiles d’or et d’argent. Et on offrit des holocaustes dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} continuellement, tous les jours de Yehoyada.
fr.B: Quand ils eurent fini, ils apportèrent au roi et à Yehoyada ce qui restait de l’argent, et on en fit des objets pour la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} : des objets pour le service et pour les holocaustes, des coupes et d’autres objets d’or et d’argent. Pendant toute la vie de Yehoyada, on offrit continuellement des holocaustes dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Quand le travail a été fini, les ouvriers ont rapporté au roi et à Yehoyada l’argent qui restait. Il a servi à faire des objets pour le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} : des objets pour le service du temple et pour les holocaustes, des coupes et d’autres objets en or et en argent. Tant que Yehoyada a vécu, on a offert des holocaustes chaque jour dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Nao walipomaliza, wakaleta mbele ya mfalme na Yehoyada fedha iliyobaki, nayo ikafanywa vyombo kwa ajili ya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, vyombo vya huduma na vya kutolea sadaka, na sahani, na vyombo vya dhahabu na fedha. Nao walikuwa wakitoa sadaka za kuteketezwa katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} daima siku zote za Yehoyada.
sw.B: Walipomaliza, walimletea mfalme na Yehoyada fedha iliyobaki, nayo wakaitumia kufanya vyombo kwa ajili ya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: vyombo vya huduma na vya sadaka za kuteketezwa, sahani, na vyombo vingine vya dhahabu na fedha. Siku zote za Yehoyada sadaka za kuteketezwa zilitolewa daima katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Kazi ilipomalizika, wafanya kazi walimletea mfalme na Yehoyada fedha iliyobaki. Ikatumika kufanyia vitu kwa ajili ya hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: vifaa vya huduma ya hekalu na vya sadaka za kuteketezwa, sahani, na vitu vingine vya dhahabu na fedha. Wakati wote Yehoyada alipokuwa hai, sadaka za kuteketezwa zilitolewa kila siku katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Khi đã xong, họ đem số bạc còn lại đến trước mặt vua và Giê-hô-gia-đa, và người ta dùng nó làm các vật dụng cho nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, các vật dụng để phục vụ và để dâng tế lễ, các chén, và các vật dụng bằng vàng và bạc. Người ta dâng của lễ thiêu trong nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} luôn luôn suốt đời Giê-hô-gia-đa.
vi.B: Khi xong việc, họ đem số bạc còn lại đến cho vua và Giê-hô-gia-đa, và người ta dùng số bạc ấy làm các vật dụng cho nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: vật dụng để phục vụ và để dâng của lễ thiêu, các chén, cùng các vật dụng khác bằng vàng và bạc. Suốt đời Giê-hô-gia-đa, của lễ thiêu được dâng thường xuyên trong nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Khi công việc xong, các thợ đem số tiền còn lại đến cho vua và Giê-hô-gia-đa. Số tiền ấy được dùng làm các đồ vật cho đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: đồ dùng cho việc thờ phượng và dâng của lễ thiêu, các chén, và những đồ vật khác bằng vàng và bạc. Bao lâu Giê-hô-gia-đa còn sống, ngày nào người ta cũng dâng của lễ thiêu trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 마치자, 남은 돈을 왕과 여호야다 앞에 가져왔다. 그리고 그것으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집을 위한 기구들, 곧 섬기는 데 쓰는 기구들과 [번제를] 드리는 데 쓰는 기구들과 접시들과 금 기구들과 은 기구들을 만들었다. 그리고 여호야다의 모든 날 동안 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 늘 번제를 드렸다.
ko.B: 그들은 일을 마친 뒤에 남은 돈을 왕과 여호야다에게 가져왔다. 그 돈으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 쓸 기구들, 곧 예배를 섬기는 데 쓰는 기구와 번제에 쓰는 기구와 접시와 그 밖의 금 기구와 은 기구를 만들었다. 여호야다가 살아 있는 동안 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서는 늘 번제가 드려졌다.
ko.R: 공사가 끝나자, 일꾼들은 남은 돈을 왕과 여호야다에게 가져왔다. 그 돈으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에서 쓸 물건들을 만들었다. 성전에서 섬기는 데 쓰는 물건과 번제에 쓰는 물건과 접시와 그 밖의 금과 은으로 만든 물건들이었다. 여호야다가 살아 있는 동안에는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에서 날마다 번제를 드렸다.

pt.L: E, quando terminaram, trouxeram diante do rei e de Joiada o resto do dinheiro, e com ele se fizeram utensílios para a casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, utensílios para o serviço e para oferecer, e colheres, e utensílios de ouro e de prata. E ofereciam holocaustos na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} continuamente, todos os dias de Joiada.
pt.B: Quando terminaram, levaram ao rei e a Joiada o dinheiro que tinha sobrado, e com ele fizeram utensílios para a casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}: utensílios para o serviço e para os holocaustos, colheres e outros utensílios de ouro e de prata. Durante todos os dias de Joiada, foram oferecidos holocaustos continuamente na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Quando o trabalho terminou, os trabalhadores levaram ao rei e a Joiada o dinheiro que tinha sobrado. Ele foi usado para fazer objetos para o templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}: objetos para o serviço do templo e para os holocaustos, vasilhas pequenas e outros objetos de ouro e de prata. Enquanto Joiada viveu, holocaustos foram oferecidos todos os dias no templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.

am.L: በጨረሱም ጊዜ የቀረውን ገንዘብ ወደ ንጉሡና ወደ ዮዳሄ አመጡ፤ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}}ም ቤት ዕቃዎች፣ የአገልግሎትና የመሥዋዕት ማቅረቢያ ዕቃዎች፣ ሳሕኖችም፣ የወርቅና የብር ዕቃዎችም ተሠሩበት። በዮዳሄም ዘመን ሁሉ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቤት ዘወትር የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ያቀርቡ ነበር።
am.B: በጨረሱም ጊዜ የቀረውን ገንዘብ ወደ ንጉሡና ወደ ዮዳሄ አመጡ፤ በእርሱም {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ ዕቃዎችን ሠሩ፦ ለአገልግሎቱና ለሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት የሚሆኑ ዕቃዎችን፣ ሳሕኖችንና ሌሎችንም የወርቅና የብር ዕቃዎች። በዮዳሄ ዘመን ሁሉ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ዘወትር ይቀርብ ነበር።
am.R: ሥራው በተጠናቀቀ ጊዜ ሠራተኞቹ የተረፈውን ገንዘብ ወደ ንጉሡና ወደ ዮዳሄ አመጡ። በዚህ ገንዘብ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ የሚያገለግሉ ነገሮች ተሠሩ፦ ለቤተ መቅደሱ አገልግሎትና ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የሚሆኑ ዕቃዎች፣ ሳሕኖችና ሌሎች ከወርቅና ከብር የተሠሩ ነገሮች። ዮዳሄ በሕይወት እስካለ ድረስ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በየቀኑ ይቀርብ ነበር።

hi.L: और जब वे समाप्त कर चुके, तब वे बचा हुआ रुपया राजा और यहोयादा के सामने ले आए, और उससे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन के लिए पात्र बनाए गए, सेवा के और चढ़ाने के पात्र, और कटोरे, और सोने और चाँदी के पात्र। और यहोयादा के सारे दिनों में {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन में नित्य होमबलियाँ चढ़ाई जाती रहीं।
hi.B: जब वे काम पूरा कर चुके, तब वे बचा हुआ धन राजा और यहोयादा के पास ले आए, और उससे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन के लिए वस्तुएँ बनाई गईं: सेवा के और होमबलियों के पात्र, कटोरे, और सोने-चाँदी की दूसरी वस्तुएँ। यहोयादा के जीवन भर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन में नित्य होमबलियाँ चढ़ाई जाती रहीं।
hi.R: जब काम पूरा हो गया, तब कारीगर बचा हुआ धन राजा और यहोयादा के पास ले आए। उससे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन के लिए वस्तुएँ बनाई गईं: भवन की सेवा और होमबलियों के पात्र, कटोरे, और सोने-चाँदी की दूसरी वस्तुएँ। जब तक यहोयादा जीवित रहा, तब तक {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन में हर दिन होमबलियाँ चढ़ाई जाती रहीं।

ru.L: И когда закончили, принесли к царю и Иодаю остаток серебра, и сделали из него утварь для дома {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, утварь для служения и для возношения, и чаши, и сосуды золотые и серебряные. И возносили всесожжения в доме {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} постоянно во все дни Иодая.
ru.B: Когда закончили, принесли остаток серебра царю и Иодаю, и из него сделали утварь для дома {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}: утварь для служения и для всесожжений, чаши и другие золотые и серебряные сосуды. Во все дни Иодая в доме {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} постоянно приносили всесожжения.
ru.R: Когда работа была закончена, работники принесли оставшиеся деньги царю и Иодаю. Из них сделали вещи для храма {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}: предметы для служения в храме и для всесожжений, чаши и другие вещи из золота и серебра. Пока Иодай был жив, в храме {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} каждый день приносили всесожжения.

ja.L: そして彼らは終えると、残りの銀を王とヨヤダの前に持って来た。そして彼はそれを{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家のための器、奉仕のための器とささげるための器、皿、金と銀の器とした。そして彼らは、ヨヤダのすべての日々、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家で絶えず焼き尽くすささげ物をささげていた。
ja.B: 工事が終わると、彼らは残りの銀を王とヨヤダのもとに持って来た。その銀で、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家のための器、すなわち奉仕のための器と焼き尽くすささげ物のための器、皿、その他の金と銀の器が作られた。ヨヤダが生きている間、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家では絶えず焼き尽くすささげ物がささげられた。
ja.R: 工事が終わると、職人たちは、残ったお金を王とヨヤダのところに持って来ました。そのお金で、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の神殿で使う道具が作られました。神殿での務めのための道具や、焼いてささげるいけにえのための道具、皿、そのほかの金や銀の道具です。ヨヤダが生きている間、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の神殿では、毎日、焼いてささげるいけにえがささげられました。

decisions.choice: the money left over made into vessels: compare 2 Kings 12:14
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 12:14 says that no gold or silver vessels were made from the money brought in. Kings speaks of the time the repairs were going on; Chronicles tells what was done with what remained once they were finished.

decisions.choice: vessels of ministering and of offering up; dishes
decisions.reason: These are the articles used in the temple service. "Offering up" is the verb used of burnt offerings, so these are vessels used with them. The dishes are small pans, used for incense (Numbers 7:14).

decisions.choice: continually, all the days of Jehoiada: regular worship while Jehoiada lived
decisions.reason: "Continually" is the word for the daily burnt offering, offered morning and evening (Numbers 28:3-6; 2 Chronicles 2:3). The phrase "all the days of Jehoiada" repeats verse 2 and prepares for what changes after his death (verse 17).

decisions.choice: he made it: it was made
decisions.reason: The verb is singular with no subject named; it means simply that the money was made into vessels.

decisions.choice: it was made into; they made; It was used to make
decisions.reason: Each level words the unnamed subject (m4) in its own way without naming who did the work.

decisions.choice: every day
decisions.reason: Readable says what "continually" means for the burnt offerings (m3).

decisions.choice: colheres (L, B), vasilhas pequenas (R); os holocaustos; continuamente (L, B), todos os dias (R)
decisions.reason: The small pans for incense (m2) take the words Numbers 7:14 gives them in Portuguese, "colher" at Literal and Balanced and "vasilha pequena" at Readable. "Holocausto" from the Old Testament terms; Readable says what "continually" means (m3), as the English does.

decisions.choice: The Amharic of 2 Kings 12:14-15 is kept where the Hebrew is the same; Kings says no vessels of gold or silver were made from the money; Chronicles says the money left over was made into vessels, so the verse is drafted from this Hebrew; dishes "ሳሕኖች" as the terms list.
decisions.reason: Chronicles retells Kings here. The terms list keeps the parallel's wording word for word where the Hebrew agrees and follows Chronicles' own Hebrew where it differs, so that a reader comparing the two sees only the real differences.

decisions.choice: olot "焼き尽くすささげ物" (L, B), "焼いてささげるいけにえ" (R), as settled from Leviticus.
decisions.reason: The offering vocabulary of LEV-1, kept for the whole Old Testament.

source.text: וַיִּזְקַ֧ן יְהוֹיָדָ֛ע וַיִּשְׂבַּ֥ע יָמִ֖ים וַיָּמֹ֑ת בֶּן־מֵאָ֧ה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים שָׁנָ֖ה בְּמוֹתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And grew old Jehoiada and was satisfied [with] days and died; [a] son of a hundred and thirty years at his death.

en.L: And Jehoiada grew old and was full of days, and he died; a son of 130 years [was he] at his death.
en.B: Jehoiada grew old and full of days, and he died. He was 130 years old when he died.
en.R: Jehoiada lived to be very old, and he had a long, full life. He was 130 years old when he died.

es.L: Y Joiada envejeció y fue lleno de días, y murió; hijo de ciento treinta años [era] al morir.
es.B: Joiada envejeció, colmado de días, y murió. Tenía ciento treinta años cuando murió.
es.R: Joiada llegó a ser muy anciano, y tuvo una vida larga y plena. Tenía ciento treinta años cuando murió.

fr.L: Et Yehoyada devint vieux et rassasié de jours, et il mourut ; [il était] fils de cent trente ans à sa mort.
fr.B: Yehoyada devint vieux et rassasié de jours, puis il mourut. Il avait cent trente ans quand il mourut.
fr.R: Yehoyada a vécu très vieux, et il a eu une vie longue et bien remplie. Il avait cent trente ans quand il est mort.

sw.L: Yehoyada akazeeka, akashiba siku, akafa; [alikuwa] mwana wa miaka 130 alipokufa.
sw.B: Yehoyada alizeeka na kushiba siku, akafa. Alikuwa na umri wa miaka 130 alipokufa.
sw.R: Yehoyada aliishi mpaka uzee mwingi, akawa na maisha marefu na kamili. Alikuwa na umri wa miaka 130 alipokufa.

vi.L: Giê-hô-gia-đa già đi và được mãn nguyện về số ngày, rồi qua đời; lúc chết ông [được] một trăm ba mươi tuổi.
vi.B: Giê-hô-gia-đa già đi, hưởng thọ cao, rồi qua đời. Ông được 130 tuổi khi qua đời.
vi.R: Giê-hô-gia-đa sống rất lâu, trọn một đời dài và đầy đủ. Ông được 130 tuổi khi qua đời.

ko.L: 그리고 여호야다가 늙어 날수가 차서 죽었다. 그가 죽을 때에 130세였다.
ko.B: 여호야다는 늙어 수명을 다 누리고 죽었다. 그가 죽을 때의 나이는 130세였다.
ko.R: 여호야다는 아주 오래 살았고, 길고 복된 삶을 누렸다. 그는 130세에 죽었다.

pt.L: E Joiada envelheceu e ficou farto de dias, e morreu; [tinha] cento e trinta anos ao morrer.
pt.B: Joiada envelheceu e morreu satisfeito com os seus anos. Tinha cento e trinta anos quando morreu.
pt.R: Joiada viveu até ficar bem velho e teve uma vida longa e plena. Ele tinha cento e trinta anos quando morreu.

am.L: ዮዳሄም ሸመገለ፤ ዕድሜም ጠግቦ ሞተ፤ በሞተ ጊዜ የ130 ዓመት ሰው ነበረ።
am.B: ዮዳሄ ሸምግሎ ዕድሜ ጠግቦ ሞተ። በሞተ ጊዜ ዕድሜው 130 ዓመት ነበር።
am.R: ዮዳሄ እጅግ ሸመገለ፤ ረጅምና የተሟላ ሕይወትም ኖረ። በሞተ ጊዜ 130 ዓመቱ ነበር።

hi.L: और यहोयादा बूढ़ा और दिनों से तृप्त होकर मर गया; अपनी मृत्यु के समय वह 130 वर्ष का [था]।
hi.B: यहोयादा बूढ़ा और पूरी आयु का होकर मर गया। मरते समय वह 130 वर्ष का था।
hi.R: यहोयादा बहुत बूढ़ा हुआ और उसने लंबी, भरपूर आयु पाई। जब वह मरा, तब वह 130 वर्ष का था।

ru.L: И состарился Иодай, и насытился днями, и умер; ста тридцати лет [он был] при своей смерти.
ru.B: Иодай состарился, насытившись днями, и умер. Ему было сто тридцать лет, когда он умер.
ru.R: Иодай дожил до глубокой старости, его жизнь была долгой и полной. Ему было сто тридцать лет, когда он умер.

ja.L: そしてヨヤダは年を取り、日々に満ち足りて、死んだ。死んだとき、彼は百三十歳であった。
ja.B: ヨヤダは年を重ね、長寿を全うして死んだ。死んだとき百三十歳であった。
ja.R: ヨヤダはとても長生きをして、満ち足りた人生を送りました。死んだとき、百三十歳でした。

decisions.choice: full of days: having lived a long and complete life
decisions.reason: The phrase is used of Abraham, Isaac, David and Job (Genesis 25:8; 35:29; 1 Chronicles 29:28; Job 42:17). It describes a life lived to its full measure, with honor.

decisions.choice: 130 years: an age beyond Moses and Joshua
decisions.reason: Moses died at 120 and Joshua at 110 (Deuteronomy 34:7; Joshua 24:29). The great age marks Jehoiada as a man God honored.

decisions.choice: he had a long, full life
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom (m1).

decisions.choice: "cent trente ans" in words
decisions.reason: The French style guide writes numbers up to "cent" in words; a short compound like this reads easily in words.

decisions.choice: figures for 130 at Balanced and Readable; words at Literal
decisions.reason: As the English level does, and as the 1 Kings drafts write numbers above one hundred.

decisions.choice: "날수가 차서" for "full of days"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of a life filled with days (m1); Balanced says "수명을 다 누리고"; the age is in figures.

decisions.choice: farto de dias (L), satisfeito com os seus anos (B); cento e trinta anos
decisions.reason: The phrase of the patriarchs' deaths (m1) keeps the words 1 Chronicles 29:28 gives it in Portuguese for David, "farto de dias" at Literal and "satisfeito com os seus anos" at Balanced. The age is written in words, as ages are in the regnal formulas, where the English gives figures.

source.text: וַיִּקְבְּרֻ֥הוּ בְעִיר־דָּוִ֖יד עִם־הַמְּלָכִ֑ים כִּֽי־עָשָׂ֤ה טוֹבָה֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְעִ֥ם הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים וּבֵיתֽוֹ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And they buried him in [the] city of David with the kings, for he had done good in Israel and with God and his house.

en.L: And they buried him in the City of David with the kings, for he had done good in Israel, and with God and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} house.
en.B: He was buried among the kings in the City of David, because of the good he had done in Israel for God and for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} house.
en.R: He was buried in the City of David with the kings, because he had done good things in Israel for God and for God's temple.

es.L: Y lo sepultaron en la ciudad de David con los reyes, porque había hecho bien en Israel, y para con Dios y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} casa.
es.B: Fue sepultado entre los reyes en la ciudad de David, por el bien que había hecho en Israel a favor de Dios y de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} casa.
es.R: Fue sepultado en la ciudad de David junto con los reyes, porque había hecho cosas buenas en Israel para Dios y para el templo de Dios.

fr.L: Et on l’enterra dans la cité de David avec les rois, car il avait fait du bien en Israël, et envers Dieu et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} maison.
fr.B: On l’enterra avec les rois dans la cité de David, à cause du bien qu’il avait fait en Israël pour Dieu et pour {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} maison.
fr.R: On l’a enterré dans la cité de David avec les rois, parce qu’il avait fait du bien en Israël pour Dieu et pour le temple de Dieu.

sw.L: Wakamzika katika mji wa Daudi pamoja na wafalme, kwa maana alikuwa amefanya mema katika Israeli, na kwa Mungu na nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Alizikwa pamoja na wafalme katika mji wa Daudi, kwa sababu ya mema aliyofanya katika Israeli kwa ajili ya Mungu na nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Alizikwa katika mji wa Daudi pamoja na wafalme, kwa sababu alikuwa amefanya mambo mema katika Israeli kwa ajili ya Mungu na hekalu la Mungu.

vi.L: Người ta chôn ông trong thành Đa-vít với các vua, vì ông đã làm điều tốt trong Y-sơ-ra-ên, đối với Đức Chúa Trời và nhà của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Ông được chôn giữa các vua trong thành Đa-vít, vì những điều tốt ông đã làm trong Y-sơ-ra-ên cho Đức Chúa Trời và cho nhà của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Ông được chôn trong thành Đa-vít với các vua, vì ông đã làm nhiều điều tốt trong Y-sơ-ra-ên cho Đức Chúa Trời và cho đền thờ của Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그를 다윗 성에 왕들과 함께 묻었다. 그가 이스라엘에서, 그리고 하나님과 그분의 집에 선을 행했기 때문이다.
ko.B: 사람들은 그를 다윗 성에 왕들과 함께 묻었다. 그가 이스라엘에서 하나님과 하나님의 집을 위하여 선한 일을 했기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그는 다윗 성에 왕들과 함께 묻혔다. 그가 이스라엘에서 하나님과 하나님의 성전을 위해 좋은 일을 많이 했기 때문이다.

pt.L: E o sepultaram na Cidade de Davi com os reis, porque tinha feito o bem em Israel, e para com Deus e a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} casa.
pt.B: Ele foi sepultado entre os reis, na Cidade de Davi, por causa do bem que tinha feito em Israel, para Deus e para a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} casa.
pt.R: Ele foi sepultado na Cidade de Davi junto com os reis, porque tinha feito coisas boas em Israel, por Deus e pelo templo de Deus.

am.L: በዳዊትም ከተማ ከነገሥታቱ ጋር ቀበሩት፤ በእስራኤል፣ ከእግዚአብሔርና ከቤቱም ጋር መልካም አድርጎ ነበርና።
am.B: በእስራኤል ለእግዚአብሔርና ለቤቱ ስላደረገው መልካም ነገር በዳዊት ከተማ ከነገሥታቱ መካከል ተቀበረ።
am.R: በእስራኤል ለእግዚአብሔርና ለእግዚአብሔር ቤተ መቅደስ መልካም ነገሮችን ስላደረገ በዳዊት ከተማ ከነገሥታቱ ጋር ተቀበረ።

hi.L: और उन्होंने उसे दाऊद के नगर में राजाओं के साथ मिट्टी दी, क्योंकि उसने इस्राएल में, और परमेश्वर और उनके भवन के लिए, भलाई की थी।
hi.B: उसे दाऊद के नगर में राजाओं के बीच मिट्टी दी गई, क्योंकि उसने इस्राएल में परमेश्वर और उनके भवन के लिए भलाई की थी।
hi.R: उसे दाऊद के नगर में राजाओं के साथ दफ़नाया गया, क्योंकि उसने इस्राएल में परमेश्वर के लिए और परमेश्वर के भवन के लिए अच्छे काम किए थे।

ru.L: И похоронили его в городе Давида с царями, потому что он сделал добро в Израиле, и для Бога, и для {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} дома.
ru.B: Его похоронили среди царей в городе Давида за то добро, которое он сделал в Израиле для Бога и для {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} дома.
ru.R: Его похоронили в городе Давида вместе с царями, потому что он сделал много доброго в Израиле для Бога и для Божьего храма.

ja.L: そして人々は彼を、王たちと共にダビデの町に葬った。彼がイスラエルにおいて、また神とその家に対して、良いことを行ったからである。
ja.B: 彼は、ダビデの町に王たちと並んで葬られた。イスラエルにおいて、神とその家のために良いことを行ったからである。
ja.R: ヨヤダは、ダビデの町に、王たちと一緒に葬られました。イスラエルで、神と神の神殿のために、良いことをたくさんしたからです。

decisions.choice: buried with the kings: an honor given to a priest
decisions.reason: Jehoiada was not of the royal line, but he was given a place among the kings in the City of David. The honor stands in contrast with Joash, who is buried in the City of David but not in the tombs of the kings (verse 25).

decisions.choice: his house: the house of God
decisions.reason: "His" most naturally refers to God, the last one named; Jehoiada had restored the king and the worship of God's house (chapter 23; verses 12-14 here). It could be read as Jehoiada's own house, but that makes less sense in a reason for an honor.

decisions.choice: He was buried
decisions.reason: "They buried him" names no one in particular; Balanced and Readable say "was buried", as with the death formula.

decisions.choice: God's temple
decisions.reason: Readable names whose house it was (m2) instead of using a pronoun.

decisions.choice: a sua casa (deity_pronoun)
decisions.reason: "His" is God's (m2), so the possessive takes the deity_pronoun span, as the English does; "a Cidade de Davi" as the burial formula has it in Kings.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span ("उनके")
decisions.reason: The Hindi text has no deity_pronoun spans (style guide, section 7); honorific forms carry respect for God at every level, here and in verses 19-20.

source.text: וְאַֽחֲרֵ֥י מוֹת֙ יְה֣וֹיָדָ֔ע בָּ֚אוּ שָׂרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ לַמֶּ֑לֶךְ אָ֛ז שָׁמַ֥ע הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And after [the] death of Jehoiada came [the] princes of Judah and bowed down to the king; then listened the king to them.

en.L: And after the death of Jehoiada the princes of Judah came and bowed down to the king; then the king listened to them.
en.B: After Jehoiada's death the officials of Judah came and bowed down to the king, and the king listened to them.
en.R: After Jehoiada died, the leaders of Judah came and bowed low before the king. And the king listened to what they said.

es.L: Y después de la muerte de Joiada vinieron los príncipes de Judá y se postraron ante el rey; entonces el rey los escuchó.
es.B: Después de la muerte de Joiada, los jefes de Judá vinieron y se postraron ante el rey, y el rey los escuchó.
es.R: Después de que murió Joiada, los dirigentes de Judá vinieron y se inclinaron profundamente ante el rey. Y el rey escuchó lo que le decían.

fr.L: Et après la mort de Yehoyada, les princes de Juda vinrent et se prosternèrent devant le roi ; alors le roi les écouta.
fr.B: Après la mort de Yehoyada, les chefs de Juda vinrent se prosterner devant le roi, et le roi les écouta.
fr.R: Quand Yehoyada est mort, les chefs de Juda sont venus s’incliner très bas devant le roi. Et le roi a écouté ce qu’ils disaient.

sw.L: Na baada ya kifo cha Yehoyada wakuu wa Yuda wakaja, wakamsujudia mfalme; ndipo mfalme akawasikiliza.
sw.B: Baada ya kifo cha Yehoyada, maafisa wa Yuda walikuja wakamsujudia mfalme, naye mfalme akawasikiliza.
sw.R: Yehoyada alipokufa, viongozi wa Yuda walikuja wakainama mbele ya mfalme. Naye mfalme akasikiliza yale waliyosema.

vi.L: Sau khi Giê-hô-gia-đa qua đời, các thủ lĩnh Giu-đa đến và quỳ lạy vua; bấy giờ vua nghe theo họ.
vi.B: Sau khi Giê-hô-gia-đa qua đời, các quan chức Giu-đa đến quỳ lạy vua, và vua nghe theo họ.
vi.R: Sau khi Giê-hô-gia-đa qua đời, các người lãnh đạo Giu-đa đến cúi rạp mình trước vua. Và vua nghe theo lời họ.

ko.L: 그리고 여호야다가 죽은 뒤에 유다의 지도자들이 와서 왕에게 절했다. 그러자 왕이 그들의 말을 들었다.
ko.B: 여호야다가 죽은 뒤에 유다의 관리들이 와서 왕에게 절하자, 왕은 그들의 말을 들어주었다.
ko.R: 여호야다가 죽은 뒤에 유다의 지도자들이 와서 왕 앞에 엎드려 절했다. 그러자 왕은 그들이 하는 말을 들어주었다.

pt.L: E depois da morte de Joiada vieram os príncipes de Judá e se prostraram diante do rei; então o rei os ouviu.
pt.B: Depois da morte de Joiada, os oficiais de Judá vieram e se prostraram diante do rei, e o rei os ouviu.
pt.R: Depois que Joiada morreu, os líderes de Judá vieram e se curvaram diante do rei. E o rei ouviu o que eles disseram.

am.L: ከዮዳሄም ሞት በኋላ የይሁዳ አለቆች መጥተው ለንጉሡ ሰገዱ፤ በዚያን ጊዜም ንጉሡ ሰማቸው።
am.B: ከዮዳሄ ሞት በኋላ የይሁዳ ሹማምንት መጥተው ለንጉሡ ሰገዱ፤ ንጉሡም ሰማቸው።
am.R: ዮዳሄ ከሞተ በኋላ የይሁዳ መሪዎች መጥተው በንጉሡ ፊት ዝቅ ብለው ሰገዱ። ንጉሡም የሚሉትን ሰማ።

hi.L: और यहोयादा की मृत्यु के बाद यहूदा के हाकिम आए और राजा को दंडवत् किया; तब राजा ने उनकी बात मानी।
hi.B: यहोयादा की मृत्यु के बाद यहूदा के अधिकारी आए और राजा के सामने झुके, और राजा ने उनकी बात मान ली।
hi.R: यहोयादा के मरने के बाद यहूदा के अगुवे आए और राजा के सामने झुककर प्रणाम किया। और राजा ने उनकी बात मान ली।

ru.L: И после смерти Иодая пришли князья Иуды и поклонились царю; тогда царь послушал их.
ru.B: После смерти Иодая пришли вельможи Иуды и поклонились царю, и царь послушал их.
ru.R: Когда Иодай умер, к царю пришли начальники Иуды и низко поклонились ему. И царь послушался их.

ja.L: そしてヨヤダの死の後、ユダの長たちが来て、王にひれ伏した。そのとき王は彼らに聞き従った。
ja.B: ヨヤダが死んだ後、ユダの高官たちが来て王にひれ伏した。そこで王は彼らの言うことを聞き入れた。
ja.R: ヨヤダが死ぬと、ユダの指導者たちが来て、王の前にひれ伏しました。王は、その人たちの言うことを聞くようになりました。

decisions.choice: after Jehoiada's death the king listened to the princes
decisions.reason: The good years were tied to Jehoiada's life (verses 2, 14). Now other voices guide the king. The text does not say what they asked, but verse 18 shows where their advice led.

decisions.choice: bowed down to the king: a sign of honor, perhaps to win his favor
decisions.reason: Bowing low is the usual way of honoring a king. Coming just after Jehoiada's death and before a request, it suggests they were seeking the king's favor for their purpose.

decisions.choice: princes (Literal); officials (Balanced); leaders (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 10.

source.text: וַיַּֽעַזְב֗וּ אֶת־בֵּ֤ית יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֔ם וַיַּֽעַבְד֥וּ אֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרִ֖ים וְאֶת־הָֽעֲצַבִּ֑ים וַֽיְהִי־קֶ֗צֶף עַל־יְהוּדָה֙ וִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם בְּאַשְׁמָתָ֖ם זֹֽאת׃

records.literal_gloss: And they forsook [the] house of Yahweh, [the] God of their fathers, and served the Asherahs and the idols; and was wrath on Judah and Jerusalem for this guilt of theirs.

en.L: And they forsook the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of their fathers, and served the Asherah poles and the idols; and wrath came on Judah and Jerusalem for this guilt of theirs.
en.B: They forsook the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of their ancestors, and served the Asherah poles and the idols. Because of this guilt of theirs, wrath came on Judah and Jerusalem.
en.R: They abandoned the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of their ancestors. They began to serve idols and the poles used to worship Asherah. Because they were guilty of this, God's anger came on Judah and Jerusalem.

es.L: Y abandonaron la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, el Dios de sus padres, y sirvieron a los postes de Aserá y a los ídolos; y vino ira sobre Judá y Jerusalén por esta culpa suya.
es.B: Abandonaron la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, el Dios de sus antepasados, y sirvieron a los postes de Aserá y a los ídolos. Por esta culpa suya, la ira vino sobre Judá y Jerusalén.
es.R: Dejaron el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, el Dios de sus antepasados. Comenzaron a servir a ídolos y a los postes que se usaban para adorar a la diosa Aserá. Como eran culpables de esto, la ira de Dios vino sobre Judá y Jerusalén.

fr.L: Et ils abandonnèrent la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu de leurs pères, et servirent les poteaux d’Ashéra et les idoles ; et la colère vint sur Juda et Jérusalem à cause de cette faute qui était la leur.
fr.B: Ils abandonnèrent la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu de leurs ancêtres, et servirent les poteaux d’Ashéra et les idoles. À cause de cette faute, la colère vint sur Juda et Jérusalem.
fr.R: Ils ont quitté le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu de leurs ancêtres. Ils se sont mis à servir les idoles et les poteaux sacrés pour adorer la déesse Ashéra. Parce qu’ils étaient coupables de cela, la colère de Dieu est venue sur Juda et Jérusalem.

sw.L: Wakaiacha nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa baba zao, wakaitumikia miti ya Ashera na sanamu; nayo ghadhabu ikaja juu ya Yuda na Yerusalemu kwa sababu ya hatia yao hii.
sw.B: Waliiacha nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa babu zao, wakaitumikia miti ya Ashera na sanamu. Kwa sababu ya hatia yao hii, ghadhabu ikaja juu ya Yuda na Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Waliliacha hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa babu zao. Wakaanza kutumikia sanamu na nguzo zilizotumiwa kumwabudu mungu wa kike Ashera. Kwa sababu walikuwa na hatia hii, hasira ya Mungu ikaja juu ya Yuda na Yerusalemu.

vi.L: Họ lìa bỏ nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ phụ họ, mà phục vụ các trụ A-sê-ra và các thần tượng; và cơn thịnh nộ giáng trên Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem vì tội lỗi này của họ.
vi.B: Họ lìa bỏ nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên họ, mà phục vụ các trụ A-sê-ra và các thần tượng. Vì tội lỗi này của họ, cơn thịnh nộ giáng trên Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Họ bỏ đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên họ. Họ bắt đầu thờ các thần tượng và các trụ dùng để thờ nữ thần A-sê-ra. Vì họ phạm tội này, cơn giận của Đức Chúa Trời giáng trên Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그들의 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집을 버리고, 아세라 목상들과 우상들을 섬겼다. 그리고 그들의 이 죄 때문에 유다와 예루살렘에 진노가 [내렸다].
ko.B: 그들은 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집을 버리고, 아세라 목상들과 우상들을 섬겼다. 그들의 이 죄 때문에 유다와 예루살렘에 진노가 내렸다.
ko.R: 그들은 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전을 저버렸다. 그리고 우상들과 아세라 목상들을 섬기기 시작했다. 그들이 이런 죄를 지었기 때문에 하나님의 진노가 유다와 예루살렘에 내렸다.

pt.L: E abandonaram a casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus dos seus pais, e serviram os postes de Aserá e os ídolos; e veio ira sobre Judá e Jerusalém por esta culpa deles.
pt.B: Eles abandonaram a casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus dos seus antepassados, e serviram os postes de Aserá e os ídolos. Por causa dessa culpa deles, a ira veio sobre Judá e Jerusalém.
pt.R: Eles abandonaram o templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus dos seus antepassados. Começaram a servir ídolos e os postes usados no culto a Aserá. Por causa dessa culpa, a ira de Deus veio sobre Judá e Jerusalém.

am.L: የአባቶቻቸውን አምላክ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ቤት ተዉ፤ አሼራዎችንና ጣዖታትንም አገለገሉ፤ ስለዚህም በደላቸው በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ ቁጣ መጣ።
am.B: የአባቶቻቸውን አምላክ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ቤተ መቅደስ ተዉ፤ የአሼራ ማምለኪያ እንጨቶችንና ጣዖታትን አገለገሉ። ስለዚህም በደላቸው በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ ቁጣ መጣ።
am.R: የአባቶቻቸውን አምላክ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ቤተ መቅደስ ተዉ። ጣዖታትንና አሼራ የምትባለውን ሴት አምላክ ለማምለክ የሚያገለግሉ የእንጨት ዘንጎችን ማገልገል ጀመሩ። በዚህ በደላቸው ምክንያት የእግዚአብሔር ቁጣ በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ መጣ።

hi.L: और उन्होंने अपने पूर्वजों के परमेश्वर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन को त्याग दिया, और अशेरा के खंभों और मूरतों की उपासना करने लगे; और उनके इस दोष के कारण यहूदा और यरूशलेम पर क्रोध भड़का।
hi.B: उन्होंने अपने पूर्वजों के परमेश्वर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन को त्याग दिया और अशेरा के खंभों और मूरतों की उपासना करने लगे। उनके इस दोष के कारण यहूदा और यरूशलेम पर क्रोध भड़का।
hi.R: उन्होंने अपने पूर्वजों के परमेश्वर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन को छोड़ दिया। वे मूर्तियों और अशेरा देवी के खंभों की पूजा करने लगे। क्योंकि वे इस बात के दोषी थे, इसलिए परमेश्वर का क्रोध यहूदा और यरूशलेम पर भड़का।

ru.L: И оставили они дом {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, Бога своих отцов, и служили столбам Ашеры и идолам; и был гнев на Иуде и Иерусалиме за эту их вину.
ru.B: Они оставили дом {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, Бога своих предков, и стали служить столбам Ашеры и идолам. За эту их вину на Иуду и Иерусалим пал гнев.
ru.R: Они бросили храм {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, Бога своих предков. Они стали служить идолам и столбам, которые ставили для поклонения Ашере. За это Божий гнев пал на Иуду и Иерусалим.

ja.L: そして彼らは、彼らの先祖の神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家を捨て、アシェラ像と偶像に仕えた。そして彼らのこの罪過のゆえに、怒りがユダとエルサレムの上に臨んだ。
ja.B: 彼らは先祖の神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家を捨て、アシェラ像と偶像に仕えた。この罪過のゆえに、怒りがユダとエルサレムに臨んだ。
ja.R: 人々は、先祖の神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の神殿から離れました。そして、偶像や、女神アシェラを拝むための木の柱に仕えるようになりました。そのような罪を犯したので、神の怒りがユダとエルサレムに下りました。

decisions.choice: they forsook the house of Yahweh: the key word of the chapter
decisions.reason: The verb "forsake" returns in Zechariah's words (verse 20), in the reason for Judah's defeat (verse 24) and in the Arameans leaving the wounded king (verse 25). The house that Joash had restored is now abandoned. Chronicles uses the word for turning from Yahweh (12:1, 5; 15:2).

decisions.choice: the Asherahs and the idols
decisions.reason: The Asherahs were wooden poles or images standing for the goddess Asherah, set up at places of worship (Deuteronomy 16:21; 2 Chronicles 14:2). The second word is a general name for idols.

decisions.choice: wrath came: Yahweh's anger
decisions.reason: The text says only "wrath", but it is the anger of Yahweh at Judah's guilt, as elsewhere in Chronicles (19:2, 10; 1 Chronicles 27:24). Verses 23-24 show it at work.

decisions.choice: forsook (Literal, Balanced); abandoned (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced use "forsake" for every use of this verb in the chapter, so the repeated word stays visible (m1); Readable uses the plainer "abandon" and "turn away".

decisions.choice: Asherah poles; poles used to worship Asherah
decisions.reason: The wording kept for this word in these books.

decisions.choice: God's anger
decisions.reason: Readable names whose wrath it was (m3).

decisions.choice: "abandonaron" (L, B); "dejaron" (R); "los postes de Aserá"
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep one verb, "abandonar", for each "forsake" in the chapter, so the repeated word stays visible (verses 20, 24); the Asherah poles as the terms note.

decisions.choice: "abandonnèrent" (Literal, Balanced), and the same verb for "forsake" through the chapter; "quitter", "abandonner" (Readable)
decisions.reason: French keeps one verb at Literal and Balanced so that the chapter's key word stays visible (m1), as the English does.

decisions.choice: kuacha (every use of "forsake" in this chapter)
decisions.reason: Swahili uses "kuacha" at every level for the verb that runs through the chapter (verses 18, 20, 24, 25), so the repetition of m1 stays visible.

decisions.choice: "các trụ A-sê-ra" (L, B); "các trụ dùng để thờ nữ thần A-sê-ra" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording, as the 1 Kings drafts.

decisions.choice: "버리다" for every use of "forsake" in the chapter (verses 18, 20, 24, 25)
decisions.reason: One Korean verb lets the repeated Hebrew word stay visible (m1); Readable says "저버리다" for forsaking God and keeps "버리다" for being left.

decisions.choice: abandonar (every level, through verse 25)
decisions.reason: The chapter's key verb (m1) is "abandonar" at every level, the word 12:5 and 15:2 use for it in Portuguese; Portuguese has one plain word where the English has "forsake" and "abandon", so Readable keeps it too, and the repetition stays visible in verses 20, 24 and 25.

decisions.choice: os postes de Aserá (L, B), os postes usados no culto a Aserá (R); os pais (L), os antepassados (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Os postes de Aserá" as Judges and Kings have them in Portuguese (m2), explained at Readable as the English does; "pais" and "antepassados" as the death formula has them.

decisions.choice: Asherah poles "አሼራዎች" (Literal), "የአሼራ ማምለኪያ እንጨቶች" (Balanced), explained at Readable; idols (atsabbim) "ጣዖታት".
decisions.reason: The Kings wording for Asherah (2 Kings 21:3), in the plural as the Hebrew has it.
Forsake is the key word of the chapter (meaning m1), kept the same in verses 20, 24 and 25; the idols as 1 Kings 15:12 in this translation.

decisions.choice: "оставить" (L, B) at every use in the chapter; "бросить", "отвернуться" (R)
decisions.reason: The chapter turns on one verb, to forsake (verses 18, 20, 24, 25); Literal and Balanced say "оставить" each time so the repetition is heard, as the English keeps "forsake".

decisions.choice: 'azav "捨てる" (L, B), "離れる" (R; "見捨てる" where God forsakes them, 24:20), kept through the chapter (24:20, 24:24, 24:25); Asherim "アシェラ像" (L, B), "女神アシェラを拝むための木の柱" (R); 'ashmah "罪過" (L, B).
decisions.reason: The meaning decision marks forsaking as the key word of the chapter, so one verb carries it.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח בָּהֶם֙ נְבִאִ֔ים לַהֲשִׁיבָ֖ם אֶל־יְהוָ֑ה וַיָּעִ֥ידוּ בָ֖ם וְלֹ֥א הֶאֱזִֽינוּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And he sent among them prophets to bring them back to Yahweh, and they testified against them, and not they gave ear.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sent prophets among them to bring them back to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and they testified against them, but they did not give ear.
en.B: Yet {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sent prophets among them to bring them back to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. The prophets warned them, but they would not listen.
en.R: Even so, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sent prophets to the people to bring them back to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. The prophets warned them, but the people would not listen.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} envió profetas entre ellos para hacerlos volver {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y ellos testificaron contra ellos, pero no escucharon.
es.B: Sin embargo, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les envió profetas para hacerlos volver {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Los profetas les advirtieron, pero ellos no quisieron escuchar.
es.R: Aun así, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} envió profetas al pueblo para hacerlo volver a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Los profetas les advirtieron, pero la gente no quiso escuchar.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} envoya parmi eux des prophètes pour les ramener {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, et ils témoignèrent contre eux, mais ils ne prêtèrent pas l’oreille.
fr.B: Pourtant {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur envoya des prophètes pour les ramener {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Les prophètes les avertirent, mais ils ne voulurent pas écouter.
fr.R: Malgré cela, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a envoyé des prophètes au peuple pour le ramener à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Les prophètes les ont avertis, mais les gens n’ont pas voulu écouter.

sw.L: Naye akatuma manabii kati yao ili kuwarudisha kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nao wakashuhudia juu yao, lakini hawakutega sikio.
sw.B: Hata hivyo aliwatuma manabii kati yao ili kuwarudisha kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Manabii hao waliwaonya, lakini hawakutaka kusikiliza.
sw.R: Hata hivyo, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwatuma manabii kwa watu ili kuwarudisha {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}. Manabii waliwaonya, lakini watu hawakutaka kusikiliza.

vi.L: Ngài sai các nhà tiên tri đến giữa họ để đem họ trở về với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; các nhà tiên tri cảnh cáo họ, nhưng họ không lắng tai nghe.
vi.B: Tuy vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vẫn sai các nhà tiên tri đến giữa họ để đem họ trở về với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Các nhà tiên tri cảnh cáo họ, nhưng họ không chịu nghe.
vi.R: Dù vậy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vẫn sai các nhà tiên tri đến với dân chúng để đem họ trở về với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Các nhà tiên tri cảnh cáo họ, nhưng dân chúng không chịu nghe.

ko.L: 그리고 주께서 그들 가운데 예언자들을 보내어 그들을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로 돌아오게 하려 하셨다. 그리고 그들이 그들에게 경고했으나, 그들은 귀를 기울이지 않았다.
ko.B: 그래도 주께서는 예언자들을 그들에게 보내어 그들을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로 돌아오게 하려 하셨다. 예언자들이 그들에게 엄히 경고했으나, 그들은 들으려 하지 않았다.
ko.R: 그래도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 예언자들을 백성에게 보내셔서 그들을 주께로 돌아오게 하려 하셨다. 예언자들이 그들에게 엄히 경고했지만, 백성은 들으려 하지 않았다.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} enviou profetas entre eles para fazê-los voltar {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, e eles testemunharam contra eles, mas não deram ouvidos.
pt.B: Mesmo assim, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} enviou profetas a eles para trazê-los de volta {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}. Os profetas os advertiram, mas eles não quiseram ouvir.
pt.R: Mesmo assim, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} enviou profetas ao povo para trazê-lo de volta para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. Os profetas advertiram o povo, mas o povo não quis ouvir.

am.L: ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይመልሷቸው ዘንድ ነቢያትን በመካከላቸው ላከ፤ እነርሱም መሰከሩባቸው፤ እነርሱ ግን አላደመጡም።
am.B: ሆኖም ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲመልሷቸው ነቢያትን በመካከላቸው ላከ። ነቢያቱ አስጠነቀቋቸው፤ እነርሱ ግን አልሰሙም።
am.R: እንዲያም ሆኖ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሕዝቡን ወደ እርሱ እንዲመልሱ ነቢያትን ላከላቸው። ነቢያቱ አስጠነቀቋቸው፤ ሕዝቡ ግን አልሰሙም።

hi.L: और उन्होंने उनके बीच भविष्यद्वक्ता भेजे कि उन्हें {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की ओर लौटा लाएँ, और उन्होंने उनके विरुद्ध गवाही दी, पर उन्होंने कान न लगाया।
hi.B: फिर भी उन्होंने उनके बीच भविष्यद्वक्ता भेजे कि उन्हें {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की ओर लौटा लाएँ। भविष्यद्वक्ताओं ने उन्हें चिताया, पर उन्होंने न सुना।
hi.R: फिर भी {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने लोगों के पास नबी भेजे कि उन्हें अपनी ओर लौटा लाएँ। नबियों ने उन्हें चिताया, पर लोगों ने न सुना।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} посылал к ним пророков, чтобы обратить их к {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, и они свидетельствовали против них, но те не слушали.
ru.B: Но {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} посылал к ним пророков, чтобы обратить их к {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}. Пророки предостерегали их, но они не слушали.
ru.R: И всё же {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} посылал к народу пророков, чтобы вернуть людей к себе. Пророки предостерегали их, но народ не слушал.

ja.L: そして彼らを{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に立ち返らせるために、彼らの間に預言者たちを遣わされた。預言者たちは彼らに対して証言したが、彼らは耳を傾けなかった。
ja.B: それでも、彼らを{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に立ち返らせようと、彼らのもとに預言者たちを遣わされた。預言者たちは彼らを戒めたが、彼らは聞こうとしなかった。
ja.R: それでも、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、人々をご自分のもとに連れ戻そうと、預言者たちを送られました。預言者たちは人々に警告しましたが、人々は耳を貸そうとしませんでした。

decisions.choice: he sent prophets: Yahweh's patience before judgment
decisions.reason: The one who sends is Yahweh. Before the wrath of verse 18 falls in full, he sends prophets to call the people back. Chronicles often tells of such warnings (36:15-16), and verse 20 gives one of them.

decisions.choice: testified against them: warned them solemnly
decisions.reason: The verb means to call as a witness, and so to warn someone with the weight of a witness behind the words, so that they are left without excuse.

decisions.choice: did not give ear: refused to listen
decisions.reason: To give ear is to listen and take heed. The people heard the prophets but would not obey.

decisions.choice: the LORD sent
decisions.reason: Readable names Yahweh as the one who sent (m1) and calls the people "the people" so the two groups are not confused.

decisions.choice: "주께서" as the subject of "sent"
decisions.reason: Korean needs the honorific subject to show that God, not the princes, sent the prophets (m1); the plain "주" stands for the pronoun and is not a divine_name span.

decisions.choice: testemunharam contra (L), advertiram (B, R); não deram ouvidos (L), não quiseram ouvir (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of witnesses (m2) and of giving ear (m3); Balanced and Readable say what they meant, as the English does.

decisions.choice: The subject of "sent" is left unnamed at L and B; the respect form "遣わされた" shows it is God.
decisions.reason: Japanese never uses 彼 for God, and naming him would add a divine_name span the English does not have.

source.text: וְר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֗ים לָֽבְשָׁה֙ אֶת־זְכַרְיָה֙ בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָ֣ע הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֖ד מֵעַ֣ל לָעָ֑ם וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לָהֶ֜ם כֹּ֣ה׀אָמַ֣ר הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים לָמָה֩ אַתֶּ֨ם עֹבְרִ֜ים אֶת־מִצְוֺ֤ת יְהוָה֙ וְלֹ֣א תַצְלִ֔יחוּ כִּֽי־עֲזַבְתֶּ֥ם אֶת־יְהוָ֖ה וַיַּֽעֲזֹ֥ב אֶתְכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] Spirit of God clothed Zechariah son of Jehoiada the priest, and he stood above the people and said to them, thus says God, why [are] you transgressing [the] commandments of Yahweh? And not you will prosper; for you have forsaken Yahweh, and he has forsaken you.

en.L: And the Spirit of God clothed Zechariah son of Jehoiada the priest, and he stood above the people and said to them, "Thus says God: 'Why are you transgressing the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}? You will not prosper! Because you have forsaken {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has forsaken you.'"
en.B: Then the Spirit of God clothed Zechariah son of Jehoiada the priest. He stood up above the people and said to them, "God says this: 'Why do you break the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}? You will not prosper. Because you have forsaken {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has forsaken you.'"
en.R: Then the Spirit of God came on Zechariah son of Jehoiada the priest and took hold of him. Zechariah stood where all the people could see him and said to them, "This is what God says: 'Why are you disobeying the commands of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}? You will not succeed. You have abandoned {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, so {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has abandoned you.'"

es.L: Y el Espíritu de Dios revistió a Zacarías hijo del sacerdote Joiada, y él se puso en pie por encima del pueblo y les dijo: «Así dice Dios: “¿Por qué {{plural_you:quebrantan|quebrantáis}} los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}? ¡No {{plural_you:prosperarán|prosperaréis}}! Porque {{plural_you:han abandonado|habéis abandonado}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:los|os}} ha abandonado”».
es.B: Entonces el Espíritu de Dios revistió a Zacarías hijo del sacerdote Joiada. Él se puso en pie en un lugar alto ante el pueblo y les dijo: «Dios dice esto: “¿Por qué {{plural_you:desobedecen|desobedecéis}} los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}? No {{plural_you:prosperarán|prosperaréis}}. Porque {{plural_you:han abandonado|habéis abandonado}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:los|os}} ha abandonado”».
es.R: Entonces el Espíritu de Dios vino sobre Zacarías hijo del sacerdote Joiada y se apoderó de él. Zacarías se puso de pie donde todo el pueblo podía verlo y les dijo: «Esto es lo que dice Dios: “¿Por qué {{plural_you:desobedecen|desobedecéis}} los mandatos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}? No {{plural_you:les|os}} irá bien. {{plural_you:Ustedes|Vosotros}} {{plural_you:han dejado|habéis dejado}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y por eso {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:los|os}} ha dejado a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}”».

fr.L: Et l’Esprit de Dieu revêtit Zacharie fils de Yehoyada le prêtre, et il se tint au-dessus du peuple et leur dit : « Ainsi parle Dieu : “Pourquoi transgressez-vous les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ? Vous ne réussirez pas ! Parce que vous avez abandonné {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous a abandonnés.” »
fr.B: Alors l’Esprit de Dieu revêtit Zacharie, fils de Yehoyada le prêtre. Il se plaça au-dessus du peuple et leur dit : « Dieu dit ceci : “Pourquoi désobéissez-vous aux commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ? Vous ne réussirez pas. Parce que vous avez abandonné {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous a abandonnés.” »
fr.R: Alors l’Esprit de Dieu est venu sur Zacharie, fils de Yehoyada le prêtre, et il l’a saisi. Zacharie s’est mis à un endroit où tout le peuple pouvait le voir, et il leur a dit : « Voici ce que dit Dieu : “Pourquoi désobéissez-vous aux commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ? Vous n’allez pas réussir. Vous avez abandonné {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous a abandonnés.” »

sw.L: Naye Roho wa Mungu akamvaa Zekaria mwana wa Yehoyada kuhani, naye akasimama juu ya watu, akawaambia, "Mungu asema hivi: 'Kwa nini mnazivunja amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}? Hamtafanikiwa! Kwa sababu mmemwacha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} naye amewaacha.'"
sw.B: Kisha Roho wa Mungu akamvaa Zekaria mwana wa Yehoyada kuhani. Akasimama juu mbele ya watu, akawaambia, "Hivi ndivyo Mungu asemavyo: 'Kwa nini mnavunja amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}? Hamtafanikiwa. Kwa kuwa mmemwacha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} naye amewaacha.'"
sw.R: Kisha Roho wa Mungu akamjia Zekaria mwana wa Yehoyada kuhani, akamshika kabisa. Zekaria akasimama mahali ambapo watu wote wangeweza kumwona, akawaambia, "Hili ndilo Mungu analosema: 'Kwa nini mnakaidi amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}? Hamtafanikiwa. Mmemwacha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa hiyo {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} naye amewaacha.'"

vi.L: Thần Linh của Đức Chúa Trời bao phủ Xa-cha-ri con trai thầy tế lễ Giê-hô-gia-đa, và ông đứng lên cao hơn dân chúng mà nói với họ: "Đức Chúa Trời phán thế này: 'Tại sao các ngươi vi phạm các điều răn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}? Các ngươi sẽ không được thịnh vượng! Vì các ngươi đã lìa bỏ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng lìa bỏ các ngươi.'"
vi.B: Bấy giờ Thần Linh của Đức Chúa Trời bao phủ Xa-cha-ri con trai thầy tế lễ Giê-hô-gia-đa. Ông đứng lên chỗ cao trước dân chúng và nói với họ: "Đức Chúa Trời phán như vầy: 'Tại sao các ngươi vi phạm các điều răn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}? Các ngươi sẽ không được thịnh vượng. Vì các ngươi đã lìa bỏ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng lìa bỏ các ngươi.'"
vi.R: Bấy giờ Thần Linh của Đức Chúa Trời đến trên Xa-cha-ri con trai thầy tế lễ Giê-hô-gia-đa và nắm lấy ông. Xa-cha-ri đứng ở chỗ mọi người có thể thấy mình và nói với họ: "Đây là lời Đức Chúa Trời phán: 'Tại sao các ngươi không vâng theo các điều răn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}? Các ngươi sẽ không thành công. Các ngươi đã bỏ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng bỏ các ngươi.'"

ko.L: 그리고 하나님의 영이 제사장 여호야다의 아들 스가랴를 옷 입듯 덮으셨다. 그리고 그가 백성 위에 서서 그들에게 말했다. "하나님께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. '어찌하여 너희가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 계명들을 어기느냐? 너희가 형통하지 못할 것이다! 너희가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 버렸으므로, 그도 너희를 버렸다.'"
ko.B: 그때 하나님의 영이 제사장 여호야다의 아들 스가랴에게 옷 입듯 임하셨다. 그는 백성보다 높은 곳에 서서 그들에게 말했다. "하나님께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. '어찌하여 너희가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 계명을 어기느냐? 너희는 형통하지 못할 것이다. 너희가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 버렸으므로, 그도 너희를 버렸다.'"
ko.R: 그때 하나님의 영이 제사장 여호야다의 아들 스가랴에게 임하셔서 그를 사로잡으셨다. 스가랴는 모든 백성이 볼 수 있는 곳에 서서 그들에게 말했다. "하나님께서 하시는 말씀은 이것이다. '어찌하여 너희가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 명령을 어기느냐? 너희는 잘되지 못할 것이다. 너희가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 저버렸으니, 그도 너희를 저버렸다.'"

pt.L: E o Espírito de Deus revestiu Zacarias, filho de Joiada, o sacerdote, e ele se pôs de pé acima do povo e lhes disse: "Assim diz Deus: 'Por que vocês transgridem os mandamentos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}? Vocês não prosperarão! Porque vocês abandonaram {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} abandonou vocês.'"
pt.B: Então o Espírito de Deus revestiu Zacarias, filho do sacerdote Joiada. Ele se pôs de pé num lugar mais alto que o povo e lhes disse: "Assim diz Deus: 'Por que vocês desobedecem aos mandamentos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}? Vocês não vão prosperar. Porque vocês abandonaram {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} abandonou vocês.'"
pt.R: Então o Espírito de Deus veio sobre Zacarias, filho do sacerdote Joiada, e tomou conta dele. Zacarias ficou de pé num lugar onde todo o povo podia vê-lo e lhes disse: "É isto que Deus diz: 'Por que vocês estão desobedecendo aos mandamentos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}? Vocês não vão ter sucesso. Vocês abandonaram {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, por isso {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} abandonou vocês.'"

am.L: የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ የካህኑን የዮዳሄን ልጅ ዘካርያስን ለበሰው፤ እርሱም ከሕዝቡ በላይ ቆሞ እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ “{{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ትእዛዛት ለምን ትተላለፋላችሁ? አይከናወንላችሁም! {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ትታችኋልና እርሱ ትቷችኋል።”»
am.B: ከዚያም የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ የካህኑን የዮዳሄን ልጅ ዘካርያስን ለበሰው። እርሱም ከሕዝቡ በላይ ቆሞ እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ “{{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ትእዛዛት ለምን ትጥሳላችሁ? አይሳካላችሁም። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ስለ ተዋችሁ እርሱም ትቷችኋል።”»
am.R: ከዚያም የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ በካህኑ በዮዳሄ ልጅ በዘካርያስ ላይ መጥቶ ያዘው። ዘካርያስ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ሊያዩት በሚችሉበት ስፍራ ቆሞ እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ “{{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ትእዛዛት ለምን አትታዘዙም? አይሳካላችሁም። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ተዋችሁ፤ ስለዚህ እርሱም ተዋችሁ።”»

hi.L: और परमेश्वर के आत्मा ने यहोयादा याजक के पुत्र जकर्याह को पहिन लिया, और उसने लोगों से ऊपर खड़े होकर उनसे कहा, "परमेश्वर यों कहते हैं: 'तुम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की आज्ञाओं का उल्लंघन क्यों करते हो? तुम सफल न होगे! क्योंकि तुमने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को त्याग दिया है, उन्होंने भी तुम्हें त्याग दिया है।'"
hi.B: तब परमेश्वर के आत्मा ने यहोयादा याजक के पुत्र जकर्याह को पहिन लिया। उसने लोगों से ऊँचे स्थान पर खड़े होकर उनसे कहा, "परमेश्वर यह कहते हैं: 'तुम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की आज्ञाओं को क्यों तोड़ते हो? तुम सफल न होगे। क्योंकि तुमने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को त्याग दिया है, उन्होंने भी तुम्हें त्याग दिया है।'"
hi.R: तब परमेश्वर का आत्मा यहोयादा याजक के पुत्र जकर्याह पर उतरा और उसे अपने वश में कर लिया। जकर्याह ऐसी जगह खड़ा हुआ जहाँ से सब लोग उसे देख सकें, और उसने उनसे कहा, "परमेश्वर यह कहते हैं: 'तुम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की आज्ञाओं को क्यों नहीं मानते? तुम सफल नहीं होगे। तुमने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को छोड़ दिया है, इसलिए उन्होंने भी तुम्हें छोड़ दिया है।'"
